title: How to update
summary: When new patches come out, patch BaconReader again with Morphe Manager: Android updates the app and keeps your login and settings.
body:
- Morphe Manager gets the new patches when it starts, or when you tap **Update** on the source in **Sources**.
- Then, on **Apps**, tap **BaconReader Premium** (or **BaconReader**), then **Patch**, then **Install → Update**. Not the install button next to **Open**: it installs the copy patched before, with the patches of then.
- The bottom of BaconReader's left menu shows which patches are installed, such as "Patches 1.8.2 (Morphe)".
caption: Patching BaconReader Premium with 1.8.1, then updating it to 1.8.2
recorded: Recorded on a Pixel 6 Pro with Morphe Manager 2.5.0.

steps.text: In Morphe Manager, tap BaconReader Premium.
Tap "No, I already have it", and pick your BaconReader Premium 6.1.4 APK.
Morphe Manager patches it with its source's patches, 1.8.1. Tap Install, then Install.
Open BaconReader. The bottom of its left menu shows the patches installed: 1.8.1.
New patches came out. In Morphe Manager, tap Sources, then the BaconReader source, then Update: it moves to 1.8.2.
On Apps, tap BaconReader Premium, then Patch.
Morphe Manager patches it with 1.8.2. Tap Install, then Update: Android keeps your login and settings.
Open BaconReader. Its left menu shows the new patches: 1.8.2.
